text:
nisha: opening follow-up thread after last night's KV-cache OOM on inference-prod-4. postmortem notes in doc; need owners, timelines, short-term mitigation.
omar: heap dumps/jemalloc in s3://debug/1742160001/{heap,jemalloc,profiles}. per-session KV hit ~120MB for some long sessions; jemalloc retained rose.
chris: recurring pattern: long sessions + accumulation. two tracks: eviction/pruning and allocator tuning.
sylvie: immediate T+24h steps: soft kv cap 30MB warn, hard cap 80MB trim/reject; supervisor auto-trim top-n; LRU+TTL for tool entries.
nisha: observability: per-session kv_size gauge, host_retained_bytes, jemalloc fragmentation. alert if >30MB for 3m or frag>1.3 for 5m.
dan: I'll implement cap+trim endpoint (/admin/trim). PR and ETA 48h.
omar: I'll run jemalloc opt (opt.retain:false, background_thread:true, decay_time=1) in staging canary and collect flamegraphs. ETA 72h.
chris: I'll add e2e regression: daily 6h long-session job (k6) to detect recurrence.
sylvie: I'll build Grafana panels and alert rules. ETA 24h.
nisha: risks: allocator changes may impact p99. plan: 10% canary -> 1h soak -> rollback if p99+10%.
dan: local repro snippets added to ticket (cgroup-limited k6, jemalloc curl, admin trim).
omar: hotspots in tokenizer and serializer; propose pooling small buffers as short-term.
chris: ownership summary: dan (caps+trim) ETA48h; omar (jemalloc experiments+pooling) ETA72h; sylvie (dashboards+alerts) ETA24h; chris (e2e job) ETA3d; nisha (coord+runbook+review) ETA Fri.
sre-bot: TASK-5310(dan),TASK-5311(omar),TASK-5312(sylvie),TASK-5313(chris) created and linked to INC-2026-03-24-17.
nisha: decision: ship soft cap+alerts first; gate hard cap+trim behind staging canary. escalate to capacity bump if >2 hosts at risk.
dan: PR #6910 WIP for cap+flag.
omar: starting 10% jemalloc A/B with MALLOC_CONF settings; will post memory/latency diffs.
sylvie: dashboard URL: https://grafana.redwood/d/kv-oom/kv-oom-overview. alert KV_SESSION_HIGH created.
chris: k6 script added and scheduled as kv-long-nightly.
nisha: please post short updates here as tasks progress; reconvene at Friday ops sync to close or escalate. thanks. :pray:
